title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Manifold Absolute Pressure sensor reporting voltage below expected range.
fullDescription:
The Engine Control Module (ECM) detected the MAP sensor signal voltage is lower than the calibrated minimum. MAP data is used to calculate engine load and fuel delivery on Harley-Davidson EFI motorcycles.

Causes include a failed MAP sensor, disconnected sensor harness, open circuit on the signal wire, or intake vacuum leaks. The bike may run rough, stall at idle, or fail emissions checks.

causes.cause: Open or shorted signal wire to ECM

fixSteps.title: Scan and confirm code
fixSteps.instruction: Use Digital Tech or OBD scanner to read ECM codes and clear history.

fixSteps.title: Inspect MAP connector
fixSteps.instruction: Locate MAP sensor on the intake, unplug and inspect for corrosion or bent pins.

fixSteps.title: Test MAP sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Back-probe signal wire with key on: should read about 4.5V at atmospheric pressure.

fixSteps.title: Replace MAP sensor if failed
fixSteps.instruction: Remove mounting screw, swap sensor, torque to spec, clear code and road test.

whenToCallPro: If wiring diagnostics are needed or code returns after sensor replacement.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P0107 MAP sensor fix

faq.a: Short distances only — fueling will be inaccurate and performance degraded.

title: IAT Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Intake Air Temperature sensor circuit voltage below threshold.
fullDescription:
ECM senses IAT signal too low, implying impossibly hot intake air or a shorted circuit. IAT input adjusts fuel mixture for air density.

Commonly caused by a failed IAT thermistor, shorted wiring, or a damaged connector. The bike may run rich and show poor fuel economy.

fixSteps.title: Read codes
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm P0112 active with scan tool.

fixSteps.title: Ohm-test IAT
fixSteps.instruction: At room temp resistance should be around 2.5k ohms. Near zero indicates short.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap IAT, reconnect, and clear code.

whenToCallPro: If harness short cannot be located with a multimeter.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P0112 IAT sensor fix

faq.q: Will the bike start with P0112?
faq.a: Yes, ECM uses a default value, but the mixture will be off.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor Low (Oil Temp on Twin Cam)
shortDescription: ET/oil temperature sensor voltage out of lower range.
fullDescription:
On liquid-cooled V-Rod and Twin-Cooled models P0117 reads ECT; on air-cooled Twin Cam it monitors cylinder head or oil temperature. Low voltage means sensor shorted or wiring grounded.

ECM will substitute a default temperature, altering fueling and ignition. Overheating protection strategies will not engage correctly.

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect sensor plug and pins for corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Resistance check
fixSteps.instruction: Cold engine resistance should be about 2k ohms; near zero confirms fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Drain minimal coolant if liquid cooled, replace sensor, torque and refill.

videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P0117 ECT sensor fix

faq.a: Minor seepage on liquid-cooled — have coolant on hand.

title: TPS Low Voltage
shortDescription: Throttle Position Sensor signal below normal range.
fullDescription:
ECM sees TPS signal voltage below expected minimum at closed throttle. On electronic throttle bikes this sets limp mode; on cable bikes it only sets a code.

Causes: out of adjustment TPS, failed sensor element, or broken signal wire. Expect poor idle and stumble.

fixSteps.title: TPS learn reset
fixSteps.instruction: Perform ECM TPS learn with scan tool at key-on engine off.

fixSteps.title: Check voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Signal wire should read 0.4-0.7V closed throttle, 4-4.5V WOT.

fixSteps.title: Replace TPS / throttle body
fixSteps.instruction: On non-serviceable units replace the complete throttle body.

whenToCallPro: Electronic throttle models require proprietary relearn.

faq.a: Ride-by-wire ECUs fail safe at 20% throttle for rider safety.

title: Front O2 Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Oxygen sensor (front cylinder) circuit reading persistently lean.
fullDescription:
Closed-loop fueling relies on O2 feedback. Low voltage indicates lean exhaust, failed sensor, or exhaust leak upstream.

Typical roots are cracked header, loose O2 bung, or aging sensor. Fueling will default to open loop reducing economy.

causes.cause: Exhaust leak ahead of O2 sensor

fixSteps.title: Inspect exhaust
fixSteps.instruction: Listen and feel for leaks at head pipe flanges with engine cold.

fixSteps.title: Fuel pressure test
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm 55-62 psi at fuel rail.

fixSteps.title: Replace front O2
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew 18mm O2 sensor, anti-seize new unit lightly on threads only.

whenToCallPro: If lean condition persists after sensor and leak checks.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P0131 O2 sensor fix

faq.a: Yes, open pipes often trigger lean codes without remapping.

title: Front Injector Low
shortDescription: Front cylinder fuel injector circuit shorted low or open.
fullDescription:
ECM drives injector by grounding one side; low-side short or open coil registers P0261. The front cylinder will miss or not fire.

Often caused by a chafed injector harness against the frame or corroded connector. Less often the injector solenoid itself has failed.

fixSteps.title: Measure injector resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Expect ~12 ohms across pins; open or short confirms fault.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Trace harness from ECM to injector for rubs and pinches.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector
fixSteps.instruction: Depressurize fuel rail, swap injector with new o-rings.

whenToCallPro: Depressurization and tank removal are risky without proper procedures.

faq.q: Can I swap injectors to diagnose?
faq.a: Yes — if the fault follows the injector the solenoid is bad.

title: Front Ignition Coil Circuit
shortDescription: Front cylinder coil primary circuit fault detected.
fullDescription:
ECM monitors coil primary for expected flyback voltage. P0351 means the expected signal is missing, indicating an open coil, bad driver, or wiring issue.

Front cylinder will not fire or will misfire under load. Bike may still run on rear cylinder only.

fixSteps.title: Coil resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Primary should read 0.5-0.7 ohms; secondary 5.5-7.5k ohms.

fixSteps.title: Swap plug wires
fixSteps.instruction: If misfire moves, the wire or coil tower is bad.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil
fixSteps.instruction: Remove tank if needed, swap coil, re-route wires away from heat.

whenToCallPro: If coil and wiring are good, ECM driver may need pro diagnosis.

faq.q: Can I ride on one cylinder?
faq.a: Do not — unburned fuel can damage catalyst.

title: Crank Position Sensor Intermittent
shortDescription: CKP signal lost or erratic during operation.
fullDescription:
ECM cannot reliably count crankshaft position pulses. P0374 sets after pulse drop-outs during normal running.

Causes: loose sensor mount, damaged reluctor ring, metallic debris on sensor tip, or failed sensor element. Engine may stall without warning.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor tip
fixSteps.instruction: Remove CKP and wipe magnetized debris from tip and bore.

fixSteps.title: Test output
fixSteps.instruction: With scope look for consistent square wave while cranking.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Torque new sensor to spec and reconnect.

videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P0374 crank sensor fix

faq.q: Is it safe to keep riding?
faq.a: Unpredictable stalls are dangerous — repair immediately.

title: System Voltage High
shortDescription: Battery voltage exceeds ECM maximum threshold.
fullDescription:
ECM measures system voltage above approximately 16V, suggesting a charging system overvoltage condition. Running with high voltage risks damaging lights, sensors, and the ECM.

Causes include a failed regulator/rectifier, bad battery, or loose ground. Address quickly to avoid collateral damage.

fixSteps.title: Measure charge voltage
fixSteps.instruction: At 3000 RPM should be 13.8-14.8V. Above 15V = regulator fault.

fixSteps.title: Check grounds
fixSteps.instruction: Clean negative cable to engine case and frame.

fixSteps.title: Replace regulator
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect battery, swap regulator, torque mount bolts.

whenToCallPro: Stator output test requires dealer equipment if regulator is new.

faq.a: Only to service — sustained overvoltage kills electronics.

title: System Voltage Low
shortDescription: Battery voltage below ECM minimum threshold.
fullDescription:
ECM logs P1003 when supply voltage sags below about 11V while running. This indicates a weak battery, failing stator, or poor connection.

Bike may run but with dim lights and eventual stall. Investigate stator and regulator output as well as battery age.

fixSteps.title: Load test battery
fixSteps.instruction: Use load tester or auto store; replace if below spec.

fixSteps.title: Measure stator AC
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug stator, engine at 2000 RPM, should read 19-26 VAC per 1000 RPM.

fixSteps.title: Replace faulty component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace battery, regulator, or stator as indicated.

whenToCallPro: Stator replacement requires primary cover removal.

faq.q: Could it be just the battery?
faq.a: Often yes — start with a battery load test.

title: Incorrect Password
shortDescription: Security system received invalid password from TSM/BCM.
fullDescription:
The ECM and Turn Signal/Body Control Module exchange a rolling password. P1009 sets when the received password does not match, usually due to module swap without programming or a dying CR2032 TSM battery.

Bike may refuse to start or require multiple key cycles to clear immobilizer.

fixSteps.title: Check TSM battery
fixSteps.instruction: Smart security fobs need a fresh CR2032 inside the fob and TSM.

fixSteps.title: Scan all modules
fixSteps.instruction: Use Digital Tech II for module handshake diagnostics.

fixSteps.title: Re-marry modules
fixSteps.instruction: Dealer procedure required to pair new TSM/ECM with password.

whenToCallPro: Re-marrying modules requires HD Digital Tech II.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P1009 security password fix

faq.a: Not without dealer-level tooling and correct PIN.

title: Rear Cylinder No Combustion
shortDescription: ECM detects missing combustion events on rear cylinder.
fullDescription:
Ion-sense or O2-based misfire logic identifies rear cylinder as not firing. Root causes: fouled plug, bad coil lead, failed injector, or mechanical compression loss.

Bike will shake and backfire through exhaust; continued operation can hydraulic-lock the cylinder with unburned fuel.

fixSteps.title: Inspect plug
fixSteps.instruction: Rear plug wet or black — start with new NGK DCPR8E or spec plug.

fixSteps.title: Check spark
fixSteps.instruction: Use inline tester on rear wire during crank.

fixSteps.title: Test compression
fixSteps.instruction: Expect 120-150 psi. Low reading indicates valve/ring issue.

whenToCallPro: Low compression indicates internal engine work.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P1354 rear misfire fix

faq.a: Every 10-15k miles on Twin Cam/Milwaukee-Eight.

title: Rear Cylinder Misfire at Idle
shortDescription: Rear cylinder misfire detected only at idle RPM.
fullDescription:
ECM logs P1356 when statistical misfire at idle exceeds limit on rear cylinder. Idle-only misfires point at vacuum leaks, dirty injector, or marginal spark.

Under load misfire clears because higher volumetric efficiency masks the leak or weak spark.

fixSteps.title: Smoke test intake
fixSteps.instruction: Apply smoke to intake; watch for leaks at manifold/T-map fitting.

fixSteps.title: Clean injectors
fixSteps.instruction: Run pro-grade injector cleaner or have injectors ultrasonic cleaned.

fixSteps.title: Replace intake seals
fixSteps.instruction: Replace rubber manifold boots if cracked.

whenToCallPro: Manifold replacement requires fuel system depressurization.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P1356 idle misfire fix

faq.a: No — mechanical leak must be found first.

title: Ignition Coil Internal Failure
shortDescription: Coil feedback suggests internal short or dwell fault.
fullDescription:
ECM monitors coil charge time. P1358 indicates coil primary draws too much or holds charge too long, signaling winding degradation.

Often progresses to P0351/P0352. Replace coil to prevent further misfires and protect ECM driver.

fixSteps.title: Measure primary
fixSteps.instruction: Primary below 0.4 ohms indicates short.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM or equivalent coil and reroute wires from heat.

fixSteps.title: Clear and retest
fixSteps.instruction: Clear codes and road test under load.

whenToCallPro: If replacement coil does not clear code, suspect ECM.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P1358 coil fault fix

faq.a: Yes if resistance matches stock — avoid low-impedance racing coils.

title: Active Exhaust Valve Fault
shortDescription: Active exhaust valve actuator circuit fault.
fullDescription:
Touring models with active exhaust use a servo to manage back pressure. P1655 sets when the actuator does not reach commanded position or has open/short circuit.

Exhaust will default to one position, possibly causing drone or power loss but engine continues to run.

fixSteps.title: Inspect linkage
fixSteps.instruction: Check cable between servo and muffler butterfly for freedom of motion.

fixSteps.title: Free the valve
fixSteps.instruction: Apply penetrating lube to valve shaft, cycle manually.

fixSteps.title: Replace servo
fixSteps.instruction: Replace actuator if it fails to move under scan tool command.

whenToCallPro: If valve is seized solid inside muffler.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle P1655 active exhaust fix

faq.a: Possible with aftermarket resistor bypass, but may not be legal.

title: Lost Communication with BCM
shortDescription: ECM cannot communicate with Body Control Module over CAN.
fullDescription:
CAN bus between ECM, BCM, instrument cluster, and ABS is disrupted. U1064 points at BCM offline. Touring bikes commonly show this after battery disconnect or fuse issue.

When BCM is offline, turn signals, horn, and security arm may not work.

fixSteps.title: Check fuses
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect BCM and ECM fuses under seat.

fixSteps.title: Measure CAN pins
fixSteps.instruction: CAN H/L should read ~2.5V idle with ~60 ohm between pins.

fixSteps.title: Reseat BCM
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug BCM connector, inspect and reseat.

videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle U1064 BCM communication fix

faq.q: Did the battery tender cause this?
faq.a: Sometimes yes — disconnect can wake a code; try clearing first.

title: Lost Communication with Speedometer/Cluster
shortDescription: ECM or BCM cannot reach the instrument cluster.
fullDescription:
The cluster provides odometer, gear indicator, and fuel level. U1097 indicates CAN communication loss with cluster, usually after water ingress or harness damage behind the fairing.

Cluster may go dark, show wrong data, or freeze. Many warning lights will activate.

fixSteps.title: Remove fairing
fixSteps.instruction: Pull outer fairing/nacelle to access cluster plugs.

fixSteps.title: Clean connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Spray electrical contact cleaner and dielectric grease.

fixSteps.title: Swap cluster if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Cluster replacement needs odometer programming at dealer.

whenToCallPro: Cluster replacement and mileage matching is dealer-only.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle U1097 cluster communication fix

faq.a: Specialist shops re-cap boards for less than new OEM cost.

title: CAN Bus Off
shortDescription: Controller has taken itself off the CAN bus due to repeated errors.
fullDescription:
Multiple CAN errors trigger the controller to go bus-off, stopping communication altogether. Usually wiring short to power or ground on CAN lines.

Bike may refuse to start or only run briefly. Diagnosing requires unplugging modules one at a time to find the offender.

causes.cause: CAN wire shorted to 12V or ground

fixSteps.title: Disconnect accessories
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug aftermarket CAN devices (amps, chargers) and retest.

fixSteps.title: Isolate modules
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug ABS, cluster, BCM one at a time to find short.

fixSteps.title: Repair harness
fixSteps.instruction: Once short isolated, repair affected wire section.

whenToCallPro: Intermittent shorts may require dealer-grade diagnostic.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle U1255 CAN bus off fix

faq.a: No — it is required for start authorization.

title: Left Handlebar Switch Fault
shortDescription: BCM reports abnormal input from left switch pack.
fullDescription:
Left handlebar pack houses turn signal, horn, and high beam buttons. B2106 sets when BCM reads implausible multi-press combinations indicating stuck switch or wiring damage.

Often caused by water intrusion in the switch housing or a pinched wire at the steering stem.

fixSteps.title: Open switch housing
fixSteps.instruction: Remove screws, separate halves, inspect PCB for corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Clean and dry
fixSteps.instruction: Use contact cleaner, dry with compressed air, reseal with dielectric grease.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch pack
fixSteps.instruction: If corroded beyond repair, replace OEM assembly.

whenToCallPro: If wiring at steering neck is chafed.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle B2106 switch pack fix

faq.a: Only if all controls work; otherwise safety issue.

title: Right Handlebar Switch Fault
shortDescription: BCM reports fault in right handlebar switch pack.
fullDescription:
Right pack contains start, run/off, hazard, and cruise buttons. B2120 indicates a stuck or shorted button. Bike may refuse to start if run switch is read as off continuously.

Fault is similar to B2106 but on the opposite side; moisture and throttle grip wiring are common culprits.

fixSteps.title: Open right housing
fixSteps.instruction: Remove torx screws, inspect PCB.

fixSteps.title: Test switches
fixSteps.instruction: Use multimeter on continuity for each button.

fixSteps.title: Replace pack
fixSteps.instruction: Install new OEM right switch assembly if faulty.

whenToCallPro: Throttle-by-wire harness issues need dealer level diagnostics.
videoSearchQuery: Harley-Davidson motorcycle B2120 right switch fix

faq.a: Only if run/off switch fails — security remains.
